description: Demo configuration for Node Export feature

instructions: 1. Select nodes in Figma that contain the structures you want to export
2. Click 'Export Selected Nodes' button in the plugin
3. Configure the root pattern (regex) to match parent containers
4. Configure sort groups to match child elements
5. Use range option for grid-like structures (tables, button groups)
6. Click 'Apply & Export' to download the JSON file

examples.prefix_regex: Item \d+ matches Item 1, Item 2, Item 3, etc.
examples.range_usage: Use range for grid patterns like Row_1_Text_Col_1, Row_1_Text_Col_2, etc.
